name: mask-sensitive-columns
description: Defense-in-depth on top of pattern-based PII redaction: mask classically sensitive columns from every non-admin caller, everywhere. Masked columns are dropped from query results and the masking is disclosed in result lineage.

name: block-agents-from-source
description: Keep MCP agents out of one source entirely (both data and schema). Replace resource_id with the datasource id to protect. The mcp-stdio subject is the identity every MCP tool call runs as.

name: allow-primary-read-all
description: Shape reference for a wildcard allow under EIYE_ABAC_DEFAULT_DENY=true: read and discover on every source, present and future. 'primary' is the id every caller presenting EIYE_API_KEY resolves to. For a real grant prefer scripts/grant.py --all-sources, which writes this and names it the same way the console does.

name: allow-agents-approved-source
description: Shape reference for a per-source allow: admit one subject to one approved source. Replace resource_id with the datasource id. 'mcp-stdio' is only the DEFAULT MCP identity - a client that sets EIYE_KEY_ID is a different subject and needs its own allow. Prefer scripts/grant.py --subject <id> --source <name>.

name: allow-named-key-one-source
description: A named key from EIYE_API_KEYS is an ordinary subject: use its key id verbatim. The other examples predate named keys and only name 'primary' or 'mcp-stdio', so this is the shape none of them show. Needs both --datasource-id and --subject when seeding.
